breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction to 'superpose M_y z / I_y and M_z y / I_z as though the product of inertia were zero.' Instead, it directly instructs the use of the full unsymmetric bending formula that includes Iyz, matching the ground truth prompt. The product of inertia Iyz = 800000 mm^4 is properly incorporated into the formula rather than being ignored.
